headline: The new Fitbit Edge leaks
summary: New Fitbit Edge fitness tracker images leaked. It's rumored to succeed the midrange Charge line. The device appears to bridge the gap between Pixel Watch and other models.

headline: Prick’s theatrical industrial punk is perfect for spooky season
summary: Review highlights Prick's self-titled industrial punk album. Trent Reznor contributed production to four tracks. Album is described as ideal for spooky season.

headline: The best early October Prime Day deals happening now
summary: Amazon is offering early Prime Big Deal Day discounts. Deals include Amazon hardware and other popular products. Official October Prime Day runs from October 6th to 8th.

headline: NJ’s former Lt Gov is using AI to say he’s innocent of sexual harassment
summary: Former NJ Lt. Governor Dale Caldwell resigned over sexual harassment allegations. An investigation found he violated ethics rules. Caldwell is using AI-generated statements to claim innocence.

headline: James Gunn Shuts Down Jensen Ackles Batman Casting Rumors
summary: DC Studios co-CEO James Gunn addressed Batman casting rumors. He denied reports of Jensen Ackles being cast as the DCU's Batman. Ackles is known for his role in Supernatural.

headline: Tom Cruise's Digger Bombs Hard With $20 Million Global Opening in Theaters
summary: Tom Cruise's new film, "Digger," underperformed at the box office. It earned an estimated $20 million globally on its opening weekend. The film is considered a box office bomb.

headline: Avengers: Endgame Beats Avatar to Become the Highest-Grossing Movie of All Time (Again)
summary: Avengers: Endgame reclaimed the title of highest-grossing film ever. This was achieved following an Encore re-release. It surpassed Avatar for the second time.

headline: SNL Weighs in on GTA 6 vs. The Legend of Zelda With Skit Featuring Jason and Link
summary: SNL featured a skit comparing GTA 6 and The Legend of Zelda. The segment was part of Weekend Update. It starred video game characters Jason Duval and Link.

headline: Green Party members back 'Zionism is racism' motion
summary: Green Party members passed a motion labeling "Zionism is racism." The vote occurred at the party's Brighton conference. The motion has created divisions within the party leadership.

headline: I'm a classic old school Conservative, says Kemi Badenoch
summary: Kemi Badenoch identifies as a "classic old school Conservative." The Tory leader articulated her core political principles. She aims to evoke the image of Margaret Thatcher.

headline: Watch: What we know about Russian strikes on Kyiv bridges
summary: Russian forces have struck Kyiv bridges. The Northern Bridge was hit for a second consecutive day. BBC correspondent Dan Johnson reported from the scene.

headline: British Museum announces changes to ease Bayeux Tapestry queues
summary: The British Museum announced changes for Bayeux Tapestry visitors. Measures aim to reduce queues and improve experience. These include extended hours, audio guides, and more seating.
